engineering_notes.3: The fork's own shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json) already maintains this curse for every spec -- only Affliction's own maintenance kept it after the three files were split apart.

notes: Rotation-accuracy program, wand-weaving addition (2026-09-28): Shoot (5019) is declared inert because this build's item table has no wand with required_level <= 10, so the ladder's level-10 rung equips nothing in the ranged slot and core.RegisterShootSpell never registers the spell there; from level 20 on it resolves and fires heavily (up to 58 percent of top casts) alongside Life Tap on this bare, no-consumes, no-buffs ladder character. Adapted from the fork's single shared warlock preset (ui/warlock/apls/rotation.apl.json). Dropped the shared preset's prepull Demonic Sacrifice (18788): this rotation plays with the demon out, and the guide takes Demonic Sacrifice only because Forever's tree makes it Soul Link's prerequisite, so the sacrifice is never cast here. An earlier version of this note said the build could not cast 18788 because spellconst has no entry for it; that was wrong. Spellconst carries class spellbook rows, and 18788 and Soul Link (19028) are talent-granted ids the client's talent table names (talents.json spell_ids), which the rank check already accepts; the engine registers both itself as APL-castable spells in sim/warlock/talents.go (applyDemonicSacrifice, applySoulLink). Soul Link before the pull (2026-10-28): the engine models it as a cast, not a passive (20 percent of base mana, a global, needs a demon out), so with no cast its 3 percent damage bonus for the warlock and the demon never applied and every Demonology sim and talent search read the talent, and Demonic Pact behind it, as worth nothing. Corruption and Life Tap were kept from the shared preset. Fixed the same stale Shadow Bolt rank the preset carried (25307 cast at rank 9 where the build's current top rank is 10). Immolate and the Bane of Agony curse maintenance from the shared preset were dropped -- Demonology's own capstone is meant to be Decimation (440870), a talent that is supposed to drop Soul Fire's 60 second cooldown to near nothing after a Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain crit. Fix round 1 (superseded): Decimation was reported as having no implementation in sim/warlock. Rotation-accuracy program (2026-09-28): sim/warlock/soul_fire.go now wires Decimation for real (applyDecimation: up to 90% cooldown reduction passively, plus the 10 s post-crit cast-time/cost window) -- but the guide's own recommended level-60 build (web/src/content/guides/warlock/demonology.md) spends 0 of Decimation's 2 points, rushing past it to reach Demonic Pact instead, so on THIS build Soul Fire still only comes off cooldown once a minute; the level-60 ladder golden confirms 17924 (rank 2) casting on that flat cadence. The guide's rotation prose is corrected to say so rather than describe a Decimation synergy this exact build does not take. Soul Fire is still placed ahead of the Shadow Bolt filler so it fires the instant it is off cooldown either way. Rotation-accuracy audit, engine numbers (2026-09-28): Corruption's and Soul Fire's base damage in sim/warlock carried classic tooltip values roughly double spellconst/warlock.json's own flat per-rank amount; fixed in the fork with a regression test each, which is why this spec's DPS dropped in this round's golden refresh -- the cast set and priority order are unchanged. Every rank named here is checked against the spellconst of the newest client build in builds/. Rotation search (2026-10-06, level 60, 800 iterations, seed 7): Soul Fire is dropped (it lost damage against the Shadow Bolt it displaced on this no-Decimation build), Immolate is added after Corruption and recast under 3 seconds remaining, and the wand gate moved from 20 to 50 percent mana; about +13 percent in that run. The search's duplicate Immolate line near the top was collapsed to the single later line, which measured the same. Rotation search (2026-10-07, level 60, 800 iterations, seed 7): Bane of Doom (603) replaces Bane of Agony as the maintained curse after the engine took Doom's damage from the learnable client row (1742, coefficient 4.0): about +0.7 percent in this spec's run (a fight shorter than a minute would not pay Doom's single hit), beyond the combined error; Curse of the Elements measured lower than Agony. Bane of Doom (2026-10-07): the Doom line replaced Bane of Agony once Bane of Doom read client row 603 (1742 at coefficient 4.0) and carried spell power; the Doom-versus-Agony and Curse of the Elements comparisons are in design/reviews/2026-10-07-warlock-ua-coe.md. Searing Pain replaced Shadow Bolt as the filler on 2026-10-08, when the rotation search measured it ahead beyond error; the unreachable Shadow Bolt line was removed. Theorycraft audit fix (2026-10-31, design/reviews/2026-10-31-theorycraft-audit/casters.md D2): the raid build takes Demonic Pact (31st Demonology point; the talent search then moved Improved Corruption, Aftermath and a Demonic Energies point into Improved Shadow Bolt, Ruin and Master Summoner, about +1.2 percent more), and the prepull summons the Imp, sacrifices it (+15% Shadow), then summons the Succubus (+10% Shadow from Master Demonologist) before Soul Link; Demonic Pact keeps the sacrifice when a different demon is summoned. With both Shadow bonuses Shadow Bolt replaces Searing Pain as the filler. About +4 percent in that run; Bane of Agony measured lower than Doom on this build. Bane of Doom in the last minute (sim-accuracy round 4, 2026-11-01): Doom deals its single hit when its minute is up, so a Doom cast with under 60 seconds left never fires; the published fight cast 3.33 Dooms for 2.13 hits. Doom now needs 60 seconds remaining, and Bane of Agony covers the last minute once Doom is down. Measured on the round-4 lane engine, horde raid, band 60, 10000 iterations at seeds 1 and 50001: Demonology about +2.5 percent, Destruction about +1.4 percent. Sim-accuracy round 7 (2026-11-02): the potion line is gone. It required the execute phase as well as low mana, so it held the Major Mana Potion to the last 35% of the fight and a 3-minute fight drank one instead of two; without the line the engine drinks it on each cooldown when mana allows, as every other caster's rotation does, which measured about 1 percent higher. Sim-accuracy round 9 (2026-11-02, owner ruling): the prepull summoned the Imp, sacrificed it and summoned the Succubus at every band, but without Demonic Pact any summon cancels the sacrifice, so the bands whose builds stop short of Pact threw the sacrifice away before the pull. The Imp summon and the sacrifice now run only when the build knows Demonic Pact (auraIsKnown 425464, a prepull condition the engine now honours); without it the prepull summons the Succubus and casts Soul Link. Those builds keep Demonic Sacrifice, which Soul Link requires, because dropping it gains less than the adoption rule's bar.

priorityList.notes: Soul Fire every 6 seconds while Decimation is up; the raid build casts it only from rank 2 at 56 to 59. Below 35% each Shadow Bolt gives you 10 seconds of Soul Fires with 40% less cast time that cost no shard, 2.4 seconds once Bane is full. The raid build casts them from rank 2 at 56, but at 60 Soul Fire is Fire, and on raid gear your Shadow bonuses make Shadow Bolt stronger. Outside Decimation it is never worth its shard.
Life Tap below 10% mana. Each tap turns health, plus a point for every point of Spirit, into mana; a Healthstone or a healer covers the health.
Curse of the Elements when no warlock's is on the target. Curses and banes have separate slots, so it sits beside your bane for five minutes; two copies do not stack, so leave it to whoever holds it.
Corruption whenever it has fallen off. A 2 second cast without Improved Corruption, and still worth it.
Bane of Doom the moment the last one fires, with a minute or more of the fight left. It hits once, hard, when its minute runs out, so a Doom cast in the last minute never lands.
Bane of Agony whenever Bane of Doom is not on the target: all fight before 60, and the last minute at 60, once Doom has fired. A new Doom would not land before the boss dies.
Immolate with 3 seconds or less left on it. It lands a moment before the old one ends, and the fresh hit is worth the last tick.

Shadow Bolt for every other cast. It beats Searing Pain, which also carries far too much threat, and once Master Demonologist gives you more Shadow damage with the Succubus out it pulls further ahead. With Demonic Pact at 40 in the raid build, the Imp's sacrifice adds 15% more on top.
Shoot only when you are out of mana and cannot Life Tap. A wand shot cannot start during a global cooldown, so it never fits between spells.
